name: alza-mcp-community
description: Unofficial MCP server for Alza.cz: product search, details, reviews and pickup points. Account and checkout tools are off by default and token-guarded.
long_description: Unofficial, community-maintained. Not affiliated with Alza.cz. Catalog tools are read-only and need no login. Account, cart and checkout tools are disabled until you enable their toolset, and anything that mutates or spends money requires a one-time confirmation token. The .mcpb bundle does not run install scripts: the first browser-backed call downloads a headless Chromium (about 92 MB, about 30 s), and the optional curl_cffi helper venv is not created (run scripts/ensure-cf-venv.sh in the extension folder to add it).
